parent_objective: design replay-calibrated M267/M264 preflight for exact-but-branch-unsafe M1013 candidates
blocked_by: M1014 requires replay calibration before threshold relaxation or new update
invalidates: blind lambda sweep continuation after M1013

public_gates: M1015 must preserve P0 actor inputs
M1015 must design only M267/M264 preflight calibration for selected M1013 exact candidates
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run full public replay stack before preflight calibration
do not relax M1011 thresholds without replay evidence
do not change actor input contract

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a minimal M267/M264 preflight to test whether M1011 strict trust gates are conservative or necessary
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no training, no PPO, no promotion, no private holdout
stop_condition: stop if M1013 exact candidates cannot be materialized reproducibly
stop if preflight would become promotion evidence
stop if private holdout would be needed
fallback_plan: if materialization is blocked, audit checkpoint export first
if design is clean, route to M1016 preflight implementation
if cadence triggers, synthesize before additional scalar objectives
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1014 chooses replay calibration before threshold changes

hypothesis: A minimal M267/M264 preflight over selected exact-but-branch-unsafe M1013 candidates can determine whether M1011 trust thresholds are too conservative or necessary.
success_criteria: preflight is limited to M267/M264 calibration
failure_criteria: design treats preflight as promotion evidence
decision_rule: M1015 should admit implementation only if it keeps the replay check to public M267/M264 preflight calibration and does not relax thresholds in-place.
